Synopsis:
Main Wulbren dialog in gnomes hideout cellar of a smithy in Rivington. Wulbren should give player a quest to destroy Gondian workshop.

Cluster Contexts:
- SCE_Wulbren.json: This dialogue is peak Wulbren. If he's met you in haven (after you saved him), he rolls back on how rude he was as he realises the player would be an amazing asset in the city. If this is your first time meeting him since the escape (if haven is destroyed he waits out on the river until this scene in the epilogue), he realises how good the player would be to have on his side in the city and tells him all about how wronged the ironhand gnomes were.
- WYR_Wulbren.json: You’re in Wulbren Bongle’s cramped gnome hideout cellar beneath a smithy in Rivington; Wulbren is an Ironhands resistance leader recently freed from a Moonrise cell (off‑screen rescue). He frames the crisis: Gondian engineers supplied Enver Gortash with the Steel Watchers and a foundry control centre (the Neurocitor) that links and drives them, and ordinary force or simple magic likely won’t stop it. The player is being recruited to destroy the Gondian workshop / Control Centre — Wulbren has built a powerful runepowder bomb and wants it taken inside to trigger an explosion (the intended solution risks wider, cascading effects on the Watcher network). The city is tense, most citizens welcome Gortash, and only scattered resistance groups remain, which explains Wulbren’s urgency and grim tone.
- MOO_Jailbreak_Wulbren.json: Wulbren is the leader of the Ironhand Gnomes. He is currently imprisoned in moonrise towers. He has the lazy charm of arrogant and the determination and cunning of the leader of a revolution. In this dialogue he offers you the main quest - to free him and the tieflings from the prison. He can speak to you through the bars - either with the player in prison, OR with the player speaking to them from the outside. NOTE: Wulbren pushes hard to charm the player and make them think they're friends. He keeps the friendly and charming mask on tight (dropping it only when he insults the player). We can have the lightest touch of menace in this dialogue, a hint that he's holding something back or that there is more to this than it seems, but it should be a light touch. He is friendly and charming here (the mask will drop back at Haven when he is rescued).
- UND_GnomeForeman.json: The gnome leader's main dialogue. He thanks you for saving them, and tells you what brought his people to the Underdark to begin with - an expedition led by their charismatic leader Wulbren, to find a forgotten gnomish explosive of awesome power - runepowder.
- WYR_Ironhand_Welcome.json: Gnome S_WYR_Ironhand_Artificer_002 stands near cave entrance into Ironhand basement lab. It greets player with a dialog. If player follows gnomes after checkpoint, they're included in the dialog.

context: You meet Wulbren Bongle in the cramped Ironhand cellar beneath a smithy in Rivington; he’s the gnome leader of the Ironhands and was recently freed from a Moonrise cell (the rescue happens off‑screen in some playthroughs). He frames the crisis: Gondian engineers supplied Enver Gortash with the Steel Watchers and a foundry control centre (the Neurocitor), and conventional force or simple magic likely won’t stop the network. Wulbren has built a powerful runepowder bomb and is recruiting you to take it into the Gondian workshop/foundry to destroy the Control Centre — an option he presents as necessary despite the danger of wider, cascading effects. The city broadly favors Gortash and resistance cells are scattered, which explains his urgent, grim tone (he can be oddly charming or rueful depending on whether you met him earlier).
